unbalanced.reason: DMN scalar-as-singleton coercion (#1755): `list contains` on a scalar route head lets the fired inclusive join COMPLETE and route (the join's completing/completed, SequenceFlowTaken join→e, the end event's lifecycle, and instance completion) where the previous release raised an ExpressionEvaluation incident and stranded the instance — head adds routing events outright; prev's IncidentRaised has no head counterpart.

divergences.rationale: upgrade-boundary: Raft members re-execute committed commands (ADR 0066, Rolling upgrade, option C), and a mixed-version cluster would journal different events for the same gateway evaluation — the new build routes `list contains` on a scalar (DMN singleton coercion) where the old build raised an incident — so the release requires an all-nodes-same-version (quiesced) upgrade with no rolling upgrade across it.
